meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 装好后，当你用触发词要求它做严苛规划时，它会先组成五个互相唱反调的评审角色，轮番攻击草案、查漏洞、提更简方案；只留下经得起挑刺的结论，再交给专门的plan代理整理成正式执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”“/hyperplan”等触发词，或要求做最严苛的规划、需要排查弱假设、盲点和过度设计时，它才会启动该模式。

say.text: hyperplan，帮我做一份新功能上线的完整规划。
say.note: 五个评审角色辩完后，plan代理写正式计划。

say.text: 用hpp对抗性评审我的发布计划，找出漏洞和假设。
say.note: 它重点查假设和边界情况。

say.text: /hyperplan 规划一下从旧系统迁移到云端的步骤。
say.note: 交叉批评后，plan代理写出步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude leads five adversarial reviewers to attack the draft, expose holes, propose simpler alternatives; surviving insights go to the plan agent for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Activates on the trigger words 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', etc., or when rigorous planning should expose weak assumptions, blind spots and over-engineering.

say_en.text: hyperplan, help me create a complete plan for the new feature launch.
say_en.note: After the five reviewers debate, the plan agent writes it.

say_en.text: Use hpp to adversarially review my release plan for weak assumptions.
say_en.note: It attacks unverified assumptions and edge cases.

say_en.text: /hyperplan, plan the steps to migrate from the legacy system to cloud.
say_en.note: After cross-critique, the plan agent writes the steps.
